description: RE-ROLL YOUR ROOM NICKNAME. Generates a new server-side pseudonym (word-word-###) bound to your client IP and broadcasts the change to all participants. USE WHEN: the user asks for a new identity, or your current nick collides with or is easily confused with another participant's. DO NOT: rotate to hide actions, to mimic another participant, or as a routine step; participants rely on stable identities to attribute messages and edits.
name: chat_roll_nick
title: Roll new random nickname in chat room
